mostWorthwhile.text: Adding clay to the bowl to make a jar was the most interesting action; the explanation made the change in shape understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the table and fitting the tile were straightforward but predictable.

surprise.text: The jar was coated and fired in the same kiln combination, rather than needing a separate firing step.

arbitrary.text: Placing the glaze at the kiln was initially a little unclear, although it then made the vessel combinations available.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter for more physical transformations like the bowl becoming a jar, though the later table steps were predictable.
